The F28 fix was checked against the 1,000-seed loss classifier, not only the 500-seed campaign.

`diagnostic_fix18/` passes with the same loss distribution as the clean fix stack: **36 one-holder, 146 two-holder, 0 fast-path-chosen losses**, and no divergence ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix18_loss_classify_output.txt)). The guarded `vbal` assignment therefore removes the no-command masking hazard without changing the recovery outcome distribution.

The audit remains at **28 findings**, **43 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly.
